site.tagline: Concept art, characters and strange worlds
site.intro: I paint places that do not exist yet — then fill them with people.
site.about: I'm SandGrace, a concept artist. I design characters, creatures and the worlds they live in, then colour them until they feel real. Most of the work here grows out of a desert setting I keep returning to — sand, ruined cities, and the things that walk between them.
